[[Saint Benedict's Preparatory School|Saint Benedict's]] ([[Newark, New Jersey]]) | college = [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]] (2009–2014) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * [[Associated Press|AP]] honorable mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2014 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2014]]) * Second team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2014) * [[College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] Most Valuable Player ([[2012 College Basketball Invitational|2012]]) }} '''Lamar Patterson''' (born August 12, 1991) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] college career at the [[University of Pittsburgh]] (Pitt). Patterson, a 6'7" [[swingman]] from [[Lancaster, Pennsylvania]], starred at [[J. P. McCaskey High School]], then [[Saint Benedict's Preparatory School]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]]. He chose to play college basketball for the [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pitt Panthers]]. During his freshman year, he suffered an ankle injury in a game against [[2009–10 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]] in November, 2009 and missed the majority of the season, gaining a [[medical redshirt]].{{cite web | last = Jones| first = Gordie| title = McCaskey product Lamar Patterson redshirting at Pitt | work = [[Lancaster Online]] | date = March 11, 2010 | url = http://lancasteronline.com/sports/mccaskey-product-lamar-patterson-redshirting-at-pitt/article_b67eae62-2baa-5d0b-85e0-fc68e60a39c9.html | accessdate = April 13, 2014}} Patterson returned to the court for the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11 season]] and became a key rotation player for the Panthers. As a redshirt sophomore in [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12]], Patterson became a starter and raised his scoring average from 2.6 [[points per game]] to 9.6. He finished the season on a high note, as he led the team to the [[2012 College Basketball Invitational]] title. Patterson averaged 13.3 points, 6 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] and 4.5 [[assists per game]] for the tournament and was named [[Most Valuable Player|MVP]].{{cite web | last = Fittipaldo| first = Ray| title = Pitt's season ends on high note with CBI win | work = [[Pittsburgh Post-Gazette]] | date = March 31, 2012 | url = http://www.post-gazette.com/home/2012/03/31/Pitt-s-season-ends-on-high-note-with-CBI-win/stories/201203310122 | accessdate = April 13, 2014}} As a junior, Patterson helped lead the Panthers back to the [[NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|NCAA Tournament]]. Once there, however, Pitt lost to eventual Final Four participant [[2012–13 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]]. Patterson returned for his senior season as the Panthers moved to the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. Patterson enjoyed a breakout season as he was one of the top players in the league, raising his scoring average to 17.1 from 10.0 as a junior.{{cite web | last = DeCourcy| first = Mike| title = Pitt's Lamar Patterson: Focus on performance, not Wooden snub | work = [[Sporting News]] | date = January 26, 2014| url = http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/story/2014-01-26/pitts-lamar-patterson-focus-on-performance-not-wooden-snub | accessdate = April 13, 2014}} At the close of the season, Patterson was named second team All-ACC by both the league's coaches and media.{{cite web | last = Zeise| first = Paul| title = Pitt standout Lamar Patterson named second-team All-ACC | work = [[Pittsburgh Post-Gazette]] | date = March 10, 2014| url = http://www.post-gazette.com/sports/Pitt/2014/03/10/Patterson-named-second-team-All-ACC/stories/201403100196 | accessdate = April 13, 2014}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.pittsburghpanthers.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/lamar_patterson_457503.html Pittsburgh athletic bio] {{Persondata | NAME = Patterson, Lamar | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = August 12, 1991 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Patterson, Lamar}} [[Category:1991 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Pennsylvania]] [[Category:People from Lancaster, Pennsylvania]] [[Category:Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
